title: 第24章 鬼斧神工，先秦炼气士仙府内的秘密！
novel_title: 先秦炼气两千年，世人误闯天家
content_zh:
那些巨大的梁柱，竟然没有任何拼接的痕迹！

    无论是墙体与地面的连接处，还是梁柱本身，都浑然一体，它们就是从一整块巨大的金属中，被直接“雕刻”出来的。

    “一整块……铸就？”

    林薇喃喃自语，她感觉自己的常识正在被一次又一次地碾碎。

    要铸造如此庞大的一座宫殿，需要多大的模具？

    需要多高的温度？

    需要多么恐怖的技术？

    这根本不是人类能完成的任务！

    【我麻了，彻底麻了，这地宫的每一个细节都在告诉我，牛顿的棺材板快压不住了。】

    【还牛顿呢？爱因斯坦来了都得懵逼！这完全是另一个维度的文明。】

    【我宣布，从今天起，我就是金大师的忠实信徒了！科学算个屁，修仙才是王道！】

    【有没有可能，所谓的淮南王刘安，根本就不是什么王爷，而是一个……外星人？这里是他的基地？】

    【这个猜测靠谱！这技术水平，绝对是星际文明级别的！】

    弹幕的讨论方向，已经彻底飞向了宇宙。

    人们用尽自己贫乏的想象力，去试图解释眼前这无法理解的一切。

    而林薇，则在短暂的失神后，强迫自己将注意力从这宏伟的建筑上移开。

    她的目光，穿过一根根巨大的梁柱，望向了这座浩瀚大殿的最中心。

    在那里，星辉最盛，光芒最亮。

    隐约之间，她看到了一个高台。

    高台之上，似乎安放着什么东西。

    那，应该就是这座地宫，这座陵墓的核心所在。

    “走，去中间看看。”
content_en:
Those huge beams and columns have no trace of splicing!

    Whether it is the connection between the wall and the ground, or the beams and columns themselves, they are all integrated. They are "carved" directly from a huge piece of metal.

    "Forged in one piece...?"

    Lin Wei murmured to herself, feeling that her common sense was being crushed again and again.

    How big of a mold would it take to cast such a huge palace?

    What temperature is needed?

    How terrible technology is needed?

    This is simply not a task that humans can accomplish!

    [I'm numb, completely numb. Every detail of this underground palace tells me that Newton's coffin board can no longer hold it. 】

    [What about Newton? When Einstein arrived, everyone was stunned! This is a civilization in another dimension entirely. 】

    [I declare that from today on, I am a loyal follower of Master Jin! Science is nothing, cultivating immortality is the way to go! 】

    [Is it possible that the so-called Huainan King Liu An is not a prince at all, but an... alien? Is this his base? 】

    [This guess is reliable! This level of technology is definitely at the level of interstellar civilization! 】

    The discussion direction of the barrage has completely flown into the universe.

    People use their poor imagination to try to explain everything that is incomprehensible before them.

    Lin Wei, on the other hand, forced herself to turn her attention away from this magnificent building after a brief absence.

    Her eyes passed through the huge beams and looked towards the center of this vast hall.

    There, the stars are the most prosperous and the light is the brightest.

    Vaguely, she saw a high platform.

    There seemed to be something placed on the high platform.

    That should be the core of this underground palace and this mausoleum.

    "Let's go and have a look in the middle."
title_en: Chapter 24: Incredible craftsmanship, the secret of the pre-Qin Qi Refiner’s Immortal Mansion!
